_comment: Dynamic variables passed to the Retell 'Marigny' conversation flow.
The flow references these by name; if one is blank, that line of the
script renders empty on a live call. src/buyer_outreach.py refuses to
dial while any required value is blank, rather than placing a call that
STABLE values live here (investor, buy box, market). PER-CALL values
(street_name, parish, callback times) are CLI arguments - see
These are business facts only the operator knows. They are deliberately
left blank rather than guessed: a wrong ARV range makes the agent
mis-qualify a real property, and a wrong investor name is said out loud
_investor_name_help: Spoken aloud in the opening line. The human the callback is with, e.g. 'James' or 'Dr. Marigny'.
parishes: Orleans and East Baton Rouge Parishes
_parishes_help: Where the investor is active, spoken naturally. e.g. 'Orleans and East Baton Rouge Parishes'
_arv_range_help: Buy box ARV range, used internally for the fit decision, not read verbatim. e.g. '$120k to $250k'
_close_timeline_help: How fast the investor closes. May be said if asked about terms. e.g. '14-day'
_default_time_option_a_help: Default first callback slot offered, e.g. 'tomorrow at 2pm'. Override per call with --time-a.
_default_time_option_b_help: Default second callback slot, e.g. 'Thursday morning'. Override per call with --time-b.
